description: This plot illustrates the massive activation of a baseline model by representing the maximum activation value across different layers for four components: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", uses a linear scale with a data range from 0 to 23, featuring numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value", uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 200. The blue dashed line, representing attn_output without markers, starts at 0 at layer 0, remains flat near 0 across most layers, and rises to roughly 250 at layer 23. The orange dotted line, representing attn_residual without markers, starts at 0 at layer 0, stays near 0 through layer 5, spikes abruptly to roughly 1400 at layer 6, gradually climbs to near 1600 by layer 15, remains steady until layer 22, and drops sharply to roughly 250 at layer 23. The green dash-dot line, representing ffn_output without markers, starts at 0 at layer 0, remains flat until spiking to roughly 1400 at layer 5, drops immediately back to near 0 at layer 6, spikes again to roughly 1000 at layer 13, drops to near 100 at layer 14, remains low with minor fluctuations until a final spike to roughly 1200 at layer 22, and ends at roughly 550 at layer 23. Finally, the red solid line, representing ffn_residual without markers, starts at 0 at layer 0, stays flat until layer 4, spikes to roughly 1400 at layer 5, rises to roughly 1500 at layer 7, remains steady until rising slightly to near 1600 at layer 14, stays flat until layer 21, drops sharply to roughly 400 at layer 22, and ends at roughly 600 at layer 23.
